ex.en: Where is the United Airlines check-in counter?
ex.zh: 聯合航空的報到櫃檯在哪裡？

ex.en: Matthew's dog, Rocky, loves to steal cupcakes off the kitchen counter.
ex.zh: 馬修的狗洛基喜歡從廚房檯面上偷紙杯蛋糕。

ex.en: Please don't leave dirty dishes on the counter.
ex.zh: 請不要把髒碗盤放在檯面上。

ex.en: When the counter value reaches the assigned 'lucky-number' it displays a congratulatory message.
ex.zh: 當計數器的數值達到預設的「幸運號碼」時，就會顯示一則恭喜訊息。

ex.en: The website has a visitor counter at the bottom of the page.
ex.zh: 這個網站的頁面底部有一個訪客計數器。

ex.en: I almost missed my connecting flight in Hong Kong.
ex.zh: 我差點在香港錯過轉機航班。

ex.en: If your first flight is late, the airline will rebook your connecting flight.
ex.zh: 如果你的第一段航班延誤，航空公司會幫你改訂轉機航班。

ex.en: The airline offered us compensation for the long delay.
ex.zh: 航空公司因為長時間延誤而提供我們賠償。

ex.en: You may be entitled to compensation if your flight is canceled.
ex.zh: 如果航班被取消，你可能有權獲得賠償。

ex.en: The job offers good compensation and benefits.
ex.zh: 這份工作提供不錯的薪酬和福利。

ex.en: Compensation includes a base salary and an annual bonus.
ex.zh: 薪酬包括底薪和年終獎金。
